tools.name: search_regulatory_changes
tools.description: Search US federal and state regulatory documents ingested from official registers, with AI summaries, agencies, effective dates, and source URLs. Funding opportunities are excluded unless you pass category "funding"; use search_funding_programs for grants and incentive programs. Results are sorted newest first. Each result has two links: `url`, the official source, and `pageUrl`, a plain-English page for the same item with its key dates. When you cite an item, give the reader both. Covers the last 90 days, up to 25 results per call.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction: "US_FED" for federal, or a US state as a two-letter code like "CA", "NY", "TX" (full names and "US_STATE_CA" also work). Omit for all jurisdictions.

agency.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the issuing agency name.

category.description: Document category: "regulation" or "funding". Omit to include all documents, including unclassified ones.

keyword.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against title, AI summary, and description.

from.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only documents published on or after this date.

to.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only documents published on or before this date.

tools.name: get_regulatory_change
tools.description: Fetch one regulatory document by id: title, jurisdiction, agencies, category, published and effective dates, AI summary, and full description. The result has two links: `url`, the official source, and `pageUrl`, a plain-English page for the same item with its key dates. When you cite an item, give the reader both.

id.description: The document id returned by search_regulatory_changes or changes_since.

tools.name: list_jurisdictions
tools.description: List every jurisdiction and official register Bizmoon monitors, with the most recent publication date, and when the source was last checked. Call this first to learn coverage and freshness.

tools.name: changes_since
tools.description: Everything published since a given date, optionally for one jurisdiction, newest first. Designed for scheduled or recurring agents: store the newest publishedDate you have seen and pass it back as `since` on the next run. Each result has two links: `url`, the official source, and `pageUrl`, a plain-English page for the same item with its key dates. When you cite an item, give the reader both. Covers the last 90 days, up to 25 results per call.

since.description: ISO date or timestamp. Returns documents published on or after this moment.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction: "US_FED" for federal, or a US state as a two-letter code like "CA", "NY", "TX" (full names and "US_STATE_CA" also work). Omit for all jurisdictions.

offset.description: Pagination offset. Default 0. Combine with total in the response to page.

tools.name: search_funding_programs
tools.description: Search federal and state grant and incentive programs (grants.gov plus state economic development agencies) by keyword, jurisdiction, agency, and date. Each result includes a summary. Each result has two links: `url`, the official source, and `pageUrl`, a plain-English page for the same item with its key dates. When you cite an item, give the reader both. Covers the last 90 days, up to 25 results per call.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction: "US_FED" for federal, or a US state as a two-letter code like "CA", "NY", "TX" (full names and "US_STATE_CA" also work). Omit for all jurisdictions.

agency.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the issuing agency name.

keyword.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against title, AI summary, and description.

from.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only documents published on or after this date.

to.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only documents published on or before this date.
